name_reason: Already conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=party-roster management on the recruitment screen, descriptor=reorder by selection. Accurately reflects the body (pack selected members to front roster slots, unselected to back). No Ghidra address residue in the name; no domain ID to preserve.
purpose: Reorders the menu/template party roster so every selected member is packed to the front (roster slots 1..K) and every unselected member drops to the back, with the lord (slot 0) never moved.
logic_summary: Sets out_slot=1, mallocs a 0xA00-byte (32 x 0x50-entry) snapshot of the current roster (data_fd2_shared_menu_party_roster_buffer_ptr) and memmoves the roster into it. Pass 1 iterates iter in [0, member_count-1) and, when sel_state[iter] != 0, memmoves snapshot entry (iter+1) into roster slot out_slot then increments out_slot. Pass 2 repeats the same loop for the sel_state[iter] == 0 (unselected) members, with out_slot continuing across both passes so the selected block is laid down first and the unselected block follows. The (iter+1) source index skips snapshot slot 0 (lord); only non-lord template chars are reordered. snapshot is freed before return. Disasm confirms: ESI=out_slot, EBX=iter, EDI=snapshot; epilogue is the Class-3 shared tail (PUSH EDI; JMP 0x301E7) regenerated by the trailing free(). __CHK(0x20) stack-probe prologue is compiler-generated; EBX/ESI/EDI callee-saved.

params.name: sel_state
params.semantics: Pointer to the per-member selection_state byte array (one byte per recruitable member; non-zero = selected). Passed by fd2_run_recruitment_or_branch_screen as (uint)selection_state, the 32-byte local toggled by the Enter key in the input loop. Indexed over [0, member_count-1) as *(char*)(sel_state + iter).
params.reason: Descriptive of its role (selection-state array pointer); no address residue; matches the src definition and the conceptual name used in sibling fd2_count_selected_chars.

returns.semantics: No return value; reorders the roster in place at data_fd2_shared_menu_party_roster_buffer_ptr and frees the temp snapshot.

issues.title: Duplicate prototypes for fd2_reorder_party_by_selection (and siblings) in protos.h
issues.description: protos.h declares fd2_reorder_party_by_selection twice: line 785 'void fd2_reorder_party_by_selection(uint32 sel_state);' and line 797 'void fd2_reorder_party_by_selection(uint32 selection_state);'. The duplication also covers fd2_count_selected_chars (lines 784 vs 796) and fd2_pin_required_char_to_party_slot1 (lines 786 vs 799), spanning two adjacent prototype blocks. The signatures are compatible (only the cosmetic param name differs), so this compiles, but the redundant block should be de-duplicated and the param name standardized to the definition's sel_state. Out of scope for this single-symbol comment-refine stage; flagged for a separate protos.h cleanup.
issues.evidence: src/include/protos.h lines 783-786 vs 795-799; misc.c definition at line 272 uses param name 'sel_state'.

notes: No src or plate change needed: misc.c comment block (lines 243-271) and the Ghidra plate are both accurate and mutually consistent vs the decompilation and the verified disassembly (snapshot 0xA00=32x0x50, two-pass pack, shared-tail epilogue via PUSH EDI; JMP 0x301E7, __CHK(0x20), EBX/ESI/EDI callee-saved). Caller fd2_run_recruitment_or_branch_screen @ 0x31a74 invokes it on Enter when fd2_count_selected_chars == max_chars (complete selection commit). Name and the single param both kept. misc.c left untouched; only this shard is staged for commit.
